title: New York Bagel Culture Shock

tweet.text: My cousin visited from France and asked why New Yorkers eat bagels like it's a religion. Then she bit into one fresh at 7am and immediately texted her mom 'we've been lied to our whole lives.' She's now extending her trip by a week.

reaction_tweet: The way she went from judging the hype to planning her mornings around a bagel shop in 48 hours is character development nobody saw coming.
